name: zigar-compiler
description: Compile Zig code into WASM or native module

scripts.test: DEV=1 TARGET=wasm BITS=32 MIXIN=track mocha -- test/*.test.js
scripts.test:wazig: USE_WAZIG=1 DEV=1 TARGET=wasm BITS=32 MIXIN=track mocha -- test/*.test.js
scripts.test:zig: USE_WAZIG=0 DEV=1 TARGET=wasm BITS=32 MIXIN=track mocha -- test/*.test.js
scripts.debug: DEV=1 TARGET=wasm BITS=32 MIXIN=track mocha --reporter spec --inspect-brk -- test/*.test.js
scripts.coverage: DEV=1 TARGET=wasm BITS=32 MIXIN=track c8 mocha -- test/*.test.js
scripts.prepack: rm -rf zig/wit-zigar zig/ts-zigar && mkdir -p zig/wit-zigar zig/ts-zigar/component && cp -r ../wit-zigar/src zig/wit-zigar/src && cp -r ../ts-zigar/src zig/ts-zigar/src && cp -r ../ts-zigar/wit zig/ts-zigar/wit && cp ../ts-zigar/component/build-component.mjs zig/ts-zigar/component/build-component.mjs && (test ! -d ../ts-zigar/component/dist || cp -r ../ts-zigar/component/dist zig/ts-zigar/component/dist)

author: Chung Leong
